title: Heart Transplants

criteria.text: Performed in a Medicare-approved heart transplant facility
criteria.span: Cardiac transplantation is covered under Medicare when performed in a facility which is approved by Medicare as meeting institutional coverage criteria.

criteria.text: No exceptions for programs < 2 years old; consortia not approved
criteria.span: Under no circumstances will exceptions be made for facilities whose transplant programs have been in existence for less than 2 years, and applications from consortia will not be approved.

criteria.text: Pediatric hospital: covered only if CMS approved its application (joint program with an approved facility, shared surgeons/QA, specialized resources)
criteria.span: Cardiac transplantation is covered for Medicare beneficiaries when performed in a pediatric hospital that performs pediatric heart transplants if the hospital submits an application which CMS approves

criteria.text: Follow-up care covered even after a noncovered transplant
criteria.span: Follow-up care is also covered for patients who have been discharged from a hospital after receiving a noncovered heart transplant.

criteria.text: Follow-up care after covered transplant, if reasonable and necessary
criteria.span: Follow-up care required as a result of a covered heart transplant is covered, provided such services are otherwise reasonable and necessary.

notes: Coverage turns on facility approval (CMS Ruling 87-1), which is not reproduced in the NCD; cases state approval status explicitly. Patient-selection criteria are not in the NCD text and are not tested. Immunosuppressive drugs and artificial hearts are cross-referenced elsewhere and not tested.
